meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取、检查和写入流式细胞术FCS文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理FCS格式的流式细胞术数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry FCS files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: 读取 FCS 2.0-3.1 格式的流式细胞术文件,提取事件矩阵、通道信息和元数据,可按需关闭预处理,也能用 NumPy 数组新建 FCS 文件,或把数据导出为 CSV/DataFrame。
howto.when: 当用户给出 .fcs 文件要求查看内容、提取数据、转换格式,或要求创建新的 FCS 文件时触发,也用于检查文件是否含多个数据集。

say.text: 读取 sample.fcs,告诉我文件版本、事件数和通道列表。
say.note: 会返回 FCS 基本信息。

say.text: 把 experiment.fcs 的事件数据按原始值导出成 CSV。
say.note: 默认做增益和对数转换,要原始值请注明。

howto.what_en: Read FCS files (v2.0-3.1), extract events as NumPy arrays, channel info, and metadata; create new FCS files or export data to CSV/DataFrame.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides an FCS file for inspection, extraction, conversion, or asks to create a new FCS file, including multi-dataset files.

say_en.text: Read sample.fcs and report version, event count, and channel list.
Export event data from experiment.fcs to CSV as raw values.
say_en.note: Preprocessing is on by default; specify raw if needed.

say_en.text: Create output.fcs from this array with channels FSC-A, SSC-A, FL1-A.
